title: Puma Deviate Pure NITRO™
body_html:
The Puma Deviate Pure NITRO™ is built for runners who want lightweight cushioning and smooth daily performance without the stiffness of a plate. Designed for everything from easy miles to uptempo training sessions, it combines a highly cushioned platform with an energetic ride that encourages you to pick up the pace naturally. With advanced NITROFOAM™ cushioning, a lightweight construction and a versatile feel underfoot, it's an ideal choice for runners seeking one shoe for daily training and speed-focused workouts.

Features:

  • Lightweight NITROFOAM™ midsole for responsive cushioning and energy return
  • Non-plated design for a smooth and natural ride
  • Neutral running shoe suitable for a wide range of runners
  • Maximum cushioning platform for comfort on longer runs
  • Engineered for road running and daily training
  • Durable rubber outsole for reliable traction
  • Regular width fit
  • Suitable for frequent runners
  • Upper made with at least 30% recycled materials

Materials:

  • Textile and synthetic upper
  • NITROFOAM™ nitrogen-infused midsole
  • Rubber outsole
  • Textile lining
  • Textile sockliner

For the best fit, we advise customers to avail of our detailed gait analysis service.
